Description
Vickers hardness testing machines are equipped with the latest optical system ideal for measuring the dimensions of indentation images. It also has a test-force loading device that lets you measure different types of specimen. It has an extent range of test force from 1.96N to 490.3N. The force is maintained for a specific dwell time in 1 second and increments between 5 and 99 seconds.
